title: POC Kickoff: Vantage Health Conversational Triage - Success Hypotheses & Runbook
summary: Working kickoff doc for a 6-week POC with Vantage Health to validate a Redwood-hosted conversational triage assistant. Focus on throughput, safety/blocking, routing to human agents, and measurable clinical triage accuracy hypotheses.
content:
Context:
- Customer: Vantage Health (outpatient network, ~120 clinics).
- Goal: Validate an LLM-powered conversational triage assistant that collects patient symptoms and returns a recommended level-of-care (self-care, telehealth, same-day clinic, ER).
- Deployment mode targeted: Redwood Hosted API for iteration, with Dedicated capacity option for scale tests.
- Duration: 6 weeks (pilot).

Objectives / primary questions to answer by end of POC:
1) Can the assistant reach clinical triage parity vs. baseline nurse-script for common symptom buckets (respiratory, abdominal, chest pain triage gating)? (target: >= 85% agreement on disposition)
2) Can we meet 95th percentile latency < 350ms for a 1024-token prompt+response flow on hosted config?
3) Does Redwood routing + fallback keep the assistant available during simulated load spikes (SLA: 99% availability during test window)?
4) Can model outputs be constrained into a structured disposition response (JSON schema) with <2% schema violation?
5) Is the privacy/data flow acceptable (PHI not stored in logs; KMS key usage validated)?

Success hypotheses (testable):
- H1: Using prefix patient history caching reduces average tokens per request by 18% in the triage flow, lowering token spend.
- H2: A canary rollout of a quantized model reduces latency tail at cost < 10% accuracy regression on top-1 disposition.
- H3: Rule-based safety layer plus UI confirmation reduces unsafe model suggestions to <0.1% on sampled clinical prompts.

Acceptance metrics (measurement plan):
- Clinical agreement: percentage agreement with clinician-labeled ground truth on a 500-case eval set maintained in the repo. Measurement: review panel labeling + blind eval. Target: >= 85%.
- Latency: p50 and p95 for end-to-end API roundtrip (including pre/post processing). Target: p95 < 350ms.
- Availability: % of successful requests during load test (10k req/min sustained burst) with fallbacks enabled. Target: >= 99%.
- Structured output validity: % of responses conforming to the disposition schema. Target: >= 98%.
- Cost delta: compare baseline (no-caching, full-precision) token cost to optimized config. Target: >= 15% cost reduction.

Scope (what we will do):
- Week 0: alignment workshop (this doc), access provisioning, test dataset handoff (anonymized cases).
- Weeks 1-2: build integration + prompt engineering; implement caching; wire UI endpoint for human-in-loop confirm.
- Weeks 3-4: internal eval and iterative tuning; safety rule set integration; initial load testing.
- Weeks 5-6: production-like stress test, final clinical evaluation, lessons learned and recommendation deck.

Out of scope for POC:
- Full EHR integration beyond synthetic/handoff payloads.
- Long-term analytics/data retention policy (we will demo an export).
- Regulatory certification (this is a validation POC only).

Data & security constraints:
- Customer requirement: no PHI written to Redwood logs. Use transient encryption and confirm retention=0 for request traces.
- Use customer-managed KMS for token encryption during Dedicated trial if we reach that stage.
- Consent: Vantage will provide anonymized patient vignettes and a small voluntary patient test pool (consents in place).

Deployment topology notes (ops):
- Default: Hosted API in us-west1. Canary path: dedicated small GPU pool in us-west1 using a quantized variant.
- Routing policy: smart routing by latency + cost; config for immediate fallback to next-capable model variant.
- Autoscale triggers: QPS > 2k sustained will trigger burst capacity (test will simulate this).

Workshop agenda (first alignment):
- 0:00 - 0:10 Introductions and roles
- 0:10 - 0:25 Customer triage goals and clinical guardrails (Vantage clinicians)
- 0:25 - 0:45 POC scope and timeline walkthrough (Redwood SEs)
- 0:45 - 1:05 Data handoff plan and anonymization checklist (security)
- 1:05 - 1:20 Success metrics and evaluation plan (testing owner: Priya)
- 1:20 - 1:30 Next steps and access checklist

Roles & owners (initial):
- Asha Khatri (SE): POC lead — overall delivery, prompts, rollout policy owner
- Diego Morales (SRE): load testing, monitoring dashboard, autoscale config
- Priya Desai (Product): evaluation plan owner, clinical dataset curator
- Ethan Park (Infra): ephemeral Dedicated cluster config, quantization testing
- Vantage clinical lead: Dr. Nora Patel — clinical signoff on ground truth labeling

Technical runbook (short form):
- Access: get Vantage API test keys, add to secrets manager (Diego)
- Dataset: Priya to upload anonymized CSV to shared S3 bucket and create manifest (format: id, age_bucket, symptom_text, gold_disposition)
- Integration test: SE to run smoke test using Redwood Hosted endpoint; ensure structured JSON output key names match UI
- Safety test: sample 1k adversarial prompts (Maya) run through safety filter, log flagged items in secure sheet only
- Load test: run k6 script (github link in artifacts) against staging for 30m ramp to 10k rps

Open questions / decisions required from customer:
- Can Vantage accept temporary retention of request metadata for debugging during Weeks 1-2? (minimally, yes/no)
- Which clinicians will be available for the blind labeling panel and what cadence for reviews?
- Are there symptom categories they specifically want excluded from automated dispositioning?

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Model over-triages low-acuity to high-acuity (false positives). Mitigation: conservative thresholds + mandatory human confirm for high-acuity outputs.
- Risk: PHI leakage. Mitigation: redact PII in preprocessor; verify logs retention policy.
- Risk: Latency SLA miss under synthetic burst. Mitigation: enable cached KV prefix and canary model with lower precision + burst capacity.

Deliverables by end of POC:
- Eval deck with clinician agreement metrics and error modes
- Runbook for production transition (ops playbook, KMS notes, routing policies)
- Final recommendation: go/no-go + suggested Dedicated sizing

Immediate next actions (within 48 hours):
- Asha: schedule alignment workshop and invite SE/SRE/Product + Vantage leads
- Priya: request anonymized dataset export and confirm consent artifacts
- Diego: create staging environment and provide test credentials template
- Vantage IT: share allowlist IPs and outbound proxy details

Notes to self / informal checklist (copied from Slack brainstorm):
- remember to include a sample patient script for UI confirmation flow
- confirm GDPR data flow for EU patients in test set (if any)
- prepare short explainer for clinicians on model limitations

Appendix: quick eval dataset schema (text):
- id: string
- age_bucket: <18|18-44|45-64|65+>
- chief_complaint: free text
- onset_time_days: integer
- comorbid_flags: comma-separated short codes
- gold_disposition: enum {self-care, telehealth, same-day-clinic, er}

End of doc.
